claim: *DocAble from the user's view.* An inaccessible document goes in; a remediated document and evidence of consequential changes come back. Internal structure is omitted because it is not yet relevant.

topology.description: Black-box transformation with document input and remediated document plus evidence output.

required_terms: Inaccessible document Unlabeled images No reading order No tags
Accessible document Described images Reading order · tags Evidence: every fix explained
What the system does; internal structure is intentionally hidden.
bw_encoding: Grayscale publication candidate. Gray distinguishes inaccessible input, production black box and remediated output; all accessibility/evidence labels retained.
redesign: Gray distinguishes inaccessible input, production black box and remediated output; all accessibility/evidence labels retained.
alt: An inaccessible document enters the closed DocAble production-system box. The output is an accessible document with described images, reading order and tags, accompanied by an evidence record explaining each fix. The black-box view shows what the system does without exposing its internals. Gray fills distinguish the source semantic roles; labels and line conventions retain their meanings.

review.reference: current authored SVG (not older D2 receipts)
review.outcome: Gray distinguishes inaccessible input, production black box and remediated output; all accessibility/evidence labels retained.
review.strict_compile: zero warnings, overfull boxes, missing glyphs or errors
